stack.nuxt_ui: transitive via @narduk-enterprises/narduk-core/nuxt module (no direct @nuxt/ui dep; UIcon/ULink/UButton/UInput/UFormField/USelect/UForm/UPagination/UApp all resolve from it)

commands.layouts: find apps/web/app/layouts -maxdepth 8 -name '*.vue' | wc -l (dir absent -> 0; app relies on narduk-core layouts)

local_reimplementations.name: RiverUnavailablePanel
local_reimplementations.notes: title+message+tone(error|neutral|warning) panel shown whenever a data section has nothing to render; widest-reused local component in the app (14 files); strong candidate to verify against/replace with AppEmptyState

local_reimplementations.name: RiverFreshnessBadge
local_reimplementations.notes: already composes NsFreshnessChip for the freshness axis (good adoption); the flood-category axis (action/minorFlood/.../recordFlood) falls back to a hand-rolled '.rs-pill' status pill because NsFreshnessChip cannot express severity - real gap for a generic status/severity badge, not a dup

local_reimplementations.name: SearchPanel
local_reimplementations.notes: 142-LOC hand-rolled search bar component with zero template consumers found via '<SearchPanel\b' grep - looks like dead code superseded by RiverRiversFilterSidebar/RiverStatesFilterControls; worth a live check before extraction, not before deletion-flagging

local_reimplementations.name: RiverRiversFilterSidebar
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled filter sidebar (state/source facets) for the rivers browse page; narduk-libs ships no filter/search bar component

local_reimplementations.name: RiverStatesFilterControls
local_reimplementations.notes: sibling hand-rolled filter control for the states browse page; near-duplicate concept of RiverRiversFilterSidebar, different markup

local_reimplementations.name: RiverHomeMetricStrip
local_reimplementations.notes: icon+label+value+detail KPI tile strip with tone variants on the homepage; narduk-libs ships no KPI/stat-tile component

pagination_control.notes: only pagination control in the app: hand-rolled 'Showing X-Y of Z' summary + UPagination (from the transitive Nuxt UI dep) driving server-paginated /api/v1/rivers; card-grid results, not a table row list

sort_control.notes: URL-query-driven two-state sort toggle (gauges|name) implemented as a UButton/NuxtLink at line ~232, not a generic sortable column header; state lives in route.query.sort

filter_search_bar.notes: state/source facet filters for rivers browse, URL-query-synced

status_chip_badge.notes: dual-purpose: NsFreshnessChip for freshness, local '.rs-pill' markup for 5 flood-severity categories

empty_state.notes: also doubles as an inline error-state panel via the tone prop; see local_reimplementations

error_state.notes: tone="error" variant of the same panel used for empty state

card_list.notes: paginated card grid of RiverRiverCard (rivers browse)

detail_list.notes: gauge observation history rows - no sort, no pagination, no search; renders whatever the server already limited. This is the app's 'history' surface (USGS/NWPS observation readings).

date_time_format.notes: formatTimestamp/getFreshnessLabel/getFloodCategoryLabel among other formatters; consumed widely via import, file-consumer count not exhaustively grepped
wraps a formatted timestamp with a fallback string; used at minimum by RiverHomeMetricStrip

number_currency_format.notes: formatNumber/formatObservationValue live here alongside date formatters, not split into a separate file

layout_shell_nav.notes: app-specific shell/nav wrapper distinct from narduk-core Layer* shells (none of which are used - see libs_components_used all-zero for Layer*)

tabs.notes: hand-rolled tabs on the homepage instead of narduk-core's AppTabs (0 consumers of AppTabs found app-wide)

map_wrapper.notes: composes AppMapKit (narduk-mapkit-nuxt) - correct adoption, not a duplicate

chart_wrapper.notes: composes NardukLineChart - correct adoption, not a duplicate

server_list_contracts.response_shape: { ok, data: T[], error, meta: { generatedAt, pagination: { limit, offset, total } } } (createPaginatedEnvelope in server/utils/api-envelope.ts)

defect_history.summary: Fix RiverStatus light and dark theme surfaces
Add RiverStatus comp guardrails and UI polish

top_extraction_candidates.name: AppEmptyState adoption/verification
top_extraction_candidates.why: 14 consumers for a 19-LOC title/message/tone panel is the single highest-leverage swap in this app if it matches AppEmptyState's contract

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionResults (card-grid variant)
top_extraction_candidates.why: server-paginated card grid with a real query-param contract (limit/offset/sort/q) behind it; a shared table/collection component needs a card-grid render mode to cover this app, not just rows

top_extraction_candidates.name: CollectionFilterBar
top_extraction_candidates.why: RiverRiversFilterSidebar and RiverStatesFilterControls duplicate the facet-filter concept with separate markup; a shared filter bar could unify both and the (possibly dead) SearchPanel

notes: No table/UTable/role=table/grid-cols-as-table pattern exists anywhere in this app - all list surfaces (rivers, gauges, states, observations) render as card grids or plain detail-row stacks, not tables. @nuxt/ui is not a direct dependency but is fully available transitively through @narduk-enterprises/narduk-core/nuxt (UIcon/ULink/UButton/UInput/UFormField/USelect/UForm/UPagination/UApp all in use) - any shared table component built on UTable would work here without adding a new direct dependency. GaugeObservationList (the closest thing to a 'history' table) has zero sort/pagination/search despite being literal time-series gauge readings.
